# Scroll area

A region with its own styled scrollbars.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A fixed-height list inside a popover or drawer. Not the whole page; let the page scroll.

- **Use it when:** A fixed-height list or panel inside a larger page.
- **Not when:** The whole page: let the page scroll.

Instead:

- [Message scroller](./message-scroller.md): A conversation that keeps the newest in view.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The region can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add scroll-area
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Scroll area reads 2 of Brand expressive's tokens. Each row follows one part of the component from its class to the value it ends at, in every theme. Change a token in the scheme and every component that reads it follows.
